description: This file contains a class `AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptionsValidator` that implements configuration validation logic for `AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions`. It ensures that the options object and its critical properties (`Invariant` and `ConnectionString`) are not null or whitespace. The class is used to validate configuration settings in an Orleans-based project.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptionsValidator
classes.description: A class that validates AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions configuration, ensuring required properties are set and not null or whitespace.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the provided AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions object, throwing exceptions if required properties are missing or invalid.
